title: Customer Churn Prediction
content: Machine learning models can estimate which customers may leave a subscription product by analyzing usage frequency support tickets and payment behavior.

title: Recommendation Systems
content: Recommendation engines rank products articles or videos by learning patterns from user behavior item metadata and similarity signals.

title: AI Knowledge Search
content: Retrieval systems use document ranking vector search and language models to help users find relevant answers in large knowledge bases.

title: Fraud Detection
content: Fraud detection systems monitor transactions for unusual patterns and assign risk scores for review.

title: Demand Forecasting
content: Forecasting models predict future demand from historical sales holidays promotions and market signals.

title: Support Ticket Routing
content: Text classification can automatically assign support tickets to the correct team based on issue descriptions and customer intent.

title: Computer Vision Quality Control
content: Image classification can identify product defects on a manufacturing line by comparing visual patterns.

title: Personalized Learning
content: Adaptive education tools recommend lessons based on student progress strengths and knowledge gaps.
